exceptions.reason: @vee-validate/zod 4.15.1 (latest stable) supports only zod 3, and no zod 3 release is patched (fixed in zod 4.6.6). zod 4 support via Standard Schema exists only in vee-validate 5.0.0-beta.0.
exceptions.control: The starter itself does not import zod; only CLI-generated forms do. Do not validate untrusted, unbounded collections with zod in this app. The gate accepts only this advisory and the exact @vee-validate/zod aggregate; any other high or critical production finding fails. Migrate to zod >=4.6.6 when vee-validate 5 is stable.
